title: Cartwise+ Membership Fee Refund Rules
content:
These are the refund rules for Cartwise+ Membership period fees. Clauses marked retired are no longer in force and are kept only as a record.

## Clauses in force

**R1. One charge per refund.** A refund always targets one captured fee charge, named by the reference number of that charge, and the membership's other charges are never summed into it.

**R2. Counting the unused-refund window.** The unused-refund window is counted in calendar days, where the charge date is day 0 and the last eligible day is the charge date plus the plan's unused-refund window days, inclusive.

**R3. Duplicate charges.** A second capture for the same plan and the same billing period start is a duplicate charge, and it is refunded in full when reported within the plan's duplicate-charge window of its capture, regardless of benefit use.

**R4. One refund per charge.** Each fee charge can be refunded at most once. The judgement rests on the membership's entries: a charge that already has a refund entry pointing at it cannot be refunded again.

**R5. Destination.** Refunds go to the plan's refund destination.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

- **Retired — full-refund window.** "A full refund is available only when the request is made within the unused-refund window counted from the day the period fee was charged." No longer in force.
- **Retired — no benefit use.** "Where a plan requires no benefit use, a full refund additionally requires that no member benefit was used since the charge (no member free-delivery, member priority-upgrade or member service-fee-rate fee waiver on the customer's orders and no credit applied on this membership, dated on or after the charge date); a full-unused refund refunds the whole charge." No longer in force.
- **Retired — prorated annual refund.** "Outside the window, or once a benefit has been used, an annual plan with a prorated refund available receives a prorated-annual refund of the unused full months, and only while no more than the plan's maximum months of the period have started; a month has started on the same day-of-month as the period start." Under that clause the unused full months were 12 less the months of the period started, and the refund was the charge multiplied by the unused full months and divided by the 12 months of a year, rounded to the cent. No longer in force.
- **Retired — monthly plans.** "Monthly plans receive no refund outside the full-refund rule." No longer in force.
- **Retired — refund ends the membership.** "A refund of a first period or renewal charge ends the membership: after a full-unused or prorated-annual refund the membership is canceled, registered as a customer request that takes effect once the customer confirms; a duplicate-charge refund leaves the membership as it is." No longer in force.

## Clause R2 illustrated (hypothetical)

| Window of 7 days, charge dated 10 June | Inside the counted window? |
|---|---|
| 10 June (day 0) | yes |
| 17 June (day 7, last eligible day) | yes |
| 18 June (day 8) | no |

## Clause R3 illustrated (hypothetical)

| Situation | Duplicate-charge refund? |
|---|---|
| Two captures for the same plan and the same period start, the second reported 59 days after its capture, window 60 days | yes, in full |
| Two captures for different period starts | no — not a duplicate charge |

superseded_clauses: A full refund is available only when the request is made within the unused-refund window counted from the day the period fee was charged.
Where refund_requires_no_benefit_use is true, a full refund additionally requires membership_msr_benefit_uses_since_charge to be 0; a refund_type of full_unused refunds the whole charge.

Outside the window, or once a benefit has been used, an annual plan (prorated_refund_allowed true) receives a prorated_annual refund of the unused full months (membership_msr_unused_full_months), and only while no more than prorated_refund_max_used_months months of the period have started; a month has started on the same day-of-month as the period start.
Monthly plans receive no refund outside the full-refund rule.

A refund of a first period or renewal charge ends the membership: after a full_unused or prorated_annual refund the membership is canceled, registered as a customer request that takes effect once the customer confirms; a duplicate_charge refund leaves the membership as it is.
